title: Keep exploration reversible and website navigation explicit
context: The owner clarified that the image belongs above the shelf hierarchy; expansion must not be confused with visiting the saved URL.
decision: Use independent controls: triangle explores, left arrow returns, title navigates the active browser tab. Show available covers automatically.
rationale: Preserve orientation and make actions predictable while revealing a bookmark's richer associated information. An image is an entry to exploration, not a reason to force website navigation.

provenance.sourceReference: Owner discussion 2026-10-16: arrow explores image above associated items and becomes left return arrow; bookmark title updates current tab; show available images by default
